name: exileapi-desktop
display_name: ExileApi MCP (Path of Exile HUD, extension)
description: Live Path of Exile 1 and 2 game state from the ExileApi / ExileCore2 HUD, with an interactive player-stats panel.
long_description: Talks to the 'Whats An AI Bridge' plugin inside the PoE1 (ExileApi) or PoE2 (ExileCore2) HUD over loopback. Read-only toward the game: never sends input. Includes the player-stats MCP App (vitals, resistances against caps, pinned stats, searchable stat table) synced with the in-game panel, plus plugin-development tools (HUD API reference from DLL metadata, plugin compile status and in-place reload, HUD logs, knowledge packs).
